slowpoke-slack-off.name: Slack Off
slowpoke-slack-off.description: Bond skill: lazes around and restores 40 HP.

slowpoke-psyshock.name: Psyshock
slowpoke-psyshock.description: Bond skill: a psychic wave at a foe up to 3 hexes away (Power 90).

slowpoke-aqua-tail.name: Aqua Tail
slowpoke-aqua-tail.description: Bond skill: swings its heavy, wet tail at an adjacent foe (Power 80).

slowpoke-regenerator.name: Regenerator
slowpoke-regenerator.description: Heals 4% of max HP at the start of each turn.

slowpoke-own-tempo.name: Own Tempo
slowpoke-own-tempo.description: Cannot be Slowed: it keeps its own pace.

slowpoke-zen-headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
slowpoke-zen-headbutt.description: New skill: a headbutt charged with willpower (Power 70).

slowpoke-delayed-pain.name: Delayed Pain
slowpoke-delayed-pain.description: Takes 20% less damage while at full HP: it notices pain late.

slowpoke-fishing-tail.name: Fishing Tail
slowpoke-fishing-tail.description: Foes it engages take 15% more damage from its allies.

slowpoke-amnesia.name: Amnesia
slowpoke-amnesia.description: New skill: empties its mind, becoming Fortified for 3 turns.

slowpoke-water-gun.name: Water Gun
slowpoke-water-gun.description: New skill: squirts water at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 60).

slowpoke-unbothered.name: Unbothered
slowpoke-unbothered.description: Heals 3% of max HP each turn while engaged with a foe.

slowpoke-telepathy.name: Telepathy
slowpoke-telepathy.description: Gives the team 1 Bond when it lands a combo.

slowpoke-iron-tail.name: Iron Tail
slowpoke-iron-tail.description: New skill: slams with its hardened tail (Power 90), Exposing the foe for 1 turn.

slowpoke-muddy-water.name: Muddy Water
slowpoke-muddy-water.description: New skill: a muddy wave at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 85); Slows 2 turns.

slowpoke-shellder-bite.name: Shellder Bite
slowpoke-shellder-bite.description: Deals 15% more damage to adjacent foes: the Shellder on its tail bites too.

slowpoke-calm-mind.name: Calm Mind
slowpoke-calm-mind.description: Its Psychic moves deal 15% more damage.

slowpoke-hydro-pump.name: Hydro Pump
slowpoke-hydro-pump.description: New skill: a torrent of water at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 95).

slowpoke-expanding-force.name: Expanding Force
slowpoke-expanding-force.description: New skill: psychic force bursts out, hitting foes within 1 hex (Power 85).

slowpoke-stubborn.name: Thick-Headed
slowpoke-stubborn.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

slowpoke-sluggish-strength.name: Slow Fury
slowpoke-sluggish-strength.description: Deals 20% more damage while below half HP.

slowpoke-unshakable-calm.name: Unshakable Calm
slowpoke-unshakable-calm.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage and cannot receive any status.

slowpoke-psychic-link.name: Psychic Link
slowpoke-psychic-link.description: Capstone. Deals 20% more to foes an ally afflicted; its non-damaging skills recharge 1 turn faster.

slowpoke-disable.name: Disable
slowpoke-disable.description: New skill: seals the skills of a foe up to 2 hexes away for 2 turns (Disabled).
